sources.entry: Voxt - Hold-to-talk voice input tool with AI transcription rules per app and URL, and built-in translation. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/hehehai/voxt) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Voxt is a macOS voice input and translation app that uses context-aware text enhancement across apps and URLs.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly a stub. It describes Voxt as a macOS voice input and translation app with context-aware text enhancement across apps and URLs. It mentions a Note Mode and a Meeting Mode that keep audio useful beyond plain text. It also says the project has moved to SGLang Omni, but gives no link or detail about that move. The README does not describe install steps, supported macOS versions, or the specific transcription engines used. The awesome-mac listing adds that it is a hold-to-talk input tool with AI transcription rules per app and URL and built-in translation.
notable: Transcription rules per app and URL (per awesome-mac listing)
Note Mode and Meeting Mode for audio beyond plain text
caveats: README is nearly empty and gives no setup or run instructions
README says the project has moved to SGLang Omni, with no link provided
macOS only, as the app is described as a macOS app
